content:
The test image shows soybean leaves with small, dark brown/black lesions scattered across the upper leaf surface, surrounded by yellow halos and chlorotic areas. This matches Septoria brown spot perfectly:
- Small, irregularly shaped dark brown spots
- Yellow chlorotic areas surrounding lesions
- Scattered distribution on upper leaf surface
- Infected leaves yellowing
- Background shows dropped yellow leaves consistent with early defoliation

The reference collage confirms this pattern — top-left shows identical small dark lesions with surrounding yellow areas on leaves showing the same progression.
